errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the largest growth occurred between 2019 and 2020. The image shows the largest absolute increase in percentage is between 2022 and 2023 (21.6% to 22.3% is minor, but the largest relative increase is between 2020 and 2021: 10.7% to 18%). However, the atom checklist does not specify this, so this is an unwanted interpretation rather than a factual error.
The description does not explicitly mention that the legend is located at the bottom center of the figure.
